This contempt case is filed by the petitioner complaining that the interim order passed by this Court in W.P.(C).
No. 39634/2016, dated 13.03.2017 is not complied with.

An affidavit is filed by the Annapoorna Vanitha Canteen vs Dr.V.S.Sajeev on 13 March, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110146117/
2 respondent and among other contentions it is stated that the license from the Municipality is obtained by the contractor on 20.06.2017.
Today when the matter is taken up, learned Government Pleader has also produced the license issued by the concerned authority under the Food Safety and Standards Act.
Therefore, I do not find any reason to pursue the contempt of court proceedings any further.
Accordingly, the contempt of court case is closed, leaving open the liberty of the petitioner to contest all the proceedings in the writ petition.

SHAJI P. CHALY JUDGE DCS Annapoorna Vanitha Canteen vs Dr.V.S.Sajeev on 13 March, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110146117/
